FX-PRESERVE-001.says: Normal with T: each strip shows only over the backdrop, by its alpha (Cs Ad + Cd (1-As)); columns 8 and 9 stay clear and every pixel keeps the backdrop's alpha.

FX-PRESERVE-002.says: Multiply with T: the multiplied colour where the backdrop is, nothing over the clear columns, the backdrop's alpha kept.

FX-PRESERVE-003.says: Screen with T, the same way.

FX-PRESERVE-004.says: Add with T, the same way.

FX-PRESERVE-005.says: Overlay (D-301, on the encoded colours) with T, the same way.

FX-PRESERVE-006.says: Normal with T and an alpha track matte over columns 0 to 4: the matte cuts the layer first, so columns 5 to 9 are the backdrop as it is.

FX-PRESERVE-007.says: Stencil Alpha with T, one solid over the whole frame at 50%: a stencil draws nothing of its own, so the switch changes nothing; the backdrop is kept at half, as D-301 has it.

FX-PRESERVE-008.says: The same layers with the switch off, as every file before D-828: plain normal over, the strips drawn over the clear columns too.

FX-PRESERVE-020.says: An adjustment layer with T: refused with the reason, as a motion-blur switch on one is (D-188); nothing is drawn without it (document 28).
FX-PRESERVE-020.reason: no preserve_transparency on a null or adjustment layer

FX-PRESERVE-021.says: A null with T: refused the same way.
FX-PRESERVE-021.reason: no preserve_transparency on a null or adjustment layer
